title: Action param dialog: draw the action's `submitText` on the submit button, falling back to Confirm
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② the consumer half of #27944. That card's spec half (the PR that names this card) adds `ActionSchema.submitText`, an optional `I18nLabel`: the label of the submit button in the dialog an action opens to collect its `params`. Nothing draws it yet, so the spec liveness ledger marks the key `planned` with `authorWarn`.
Reach: every action with `params` opened from the record header, a list row's menu or the toolbar. HotCRM `send_email`, `log_call`, `log_meeting`.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`.
Lands after: the #27944 spec PR (it declares the key this card reads).

## Observed
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` draws `t('actionDialog.confirm')` ("Confirm") on the submit button for every action. The two param-collection handlers (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx#paramCollectionHandler`, `RecordDetailView.tsx#paramCollectionHandler`) pass the dialog the action's title and its `description` (through `actionDescription(...)`), and nothing for the button.

## Wanted
- Both param-collection handlers resolve the action's `submitText` the way they resolve `description`: the bundle's `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText` (`globalActions.ACTION.submitText` for an object-less action) first, then the authored inline locale map collapsed to the active language, then the authored string. They pass it to `ActionParamDialog`.
- `ActionParamDialog` draws it on the submit button and falls back to `actionDialog.confirm` when there is none. The uploading state keeps `actionDialog.uploading`.
- `UIActionSchema` (`@object-ui/types`) declares `submitText`, derived from the spec's `ActionSchema`.
- The spec liveness row `submitText` (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`) flips to `live` with these read points and drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in the same edit.
- In that same change, the Studio action form offers the key: delete the `action` / `submitText` omit row in `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` and add a `submitText` row to `packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts` (its `metadata-forms` translations in `@objectstack/platform-objects` regenerate with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`).

Dedupe words: param dialog submit label, submitText, actionDialog.confirm, action verb button.

Related: #27944.

Blocked-by: #27944
